instruction: Speak in Spanish. Speak like a friendly and energetic person at an open-air market, calling out to passersby to praise the quality of their goods.
text: ¡Miren qué fresas! Recién traídas de la huerta esta misma mañana. ¡El olor lo dice todo, pura dulzura y sabor!

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio perfectly captures the requested persona of an energetic street vendor, loudly and enthusiastically calling out to passersby with great vocal projection.

instruction_evidence.social_role: Distinctly sounds like a market vendor pitching their goods to a crowd.
instruction_evidence.delivery: The tone is very energetic, loud, and friendly, effectively simulating the act of calling out.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The voice projects well and maintains a smooth, human-like quality despite the loud delivery.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: Highly expressive delivery with excellent dynamic range and enthusiasm, perfectly matching the scenario.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Deliver the text with a very fast, rhythmic, and high-energy voice, characteristic of someone calling out items for sale at a rapid pace.
text: Tenemos aquí una pieza única, madera de roble tallada a mano, con incrustaciones de nácar, un verdadero trabajo de artesanía fina.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio successfully captures the fast, rhythmic, and high-energy delivery requested, strongly evoking the persona of an auctioneer or rapid-fire seller.

instruction_evidence.speed_and_rhythm: The speech rate is very fast and maintains a steady, rhythmic pacing.
instruction_evidence.energy_and_persona: The delivery is high-energy, effectively mimicking the urgent and enthusiastic tone of someone calling out items for sale.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The voice sounds somewhat artificially sped up and has slightly unnatural, high-pitched synthetic qualities.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The vocal delivery is highly expressive, matching the intense energy and distinct rhythm needed for the requested persona.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Use a polite, patient, and professional tone, as if you're guiding a client through a set of instructions over the phone.
text: Primero, asegúrese de que el dispositivo esté conectado a la corriente. A continuación, mantenga presionado el botón de encendido durante cinco segundos hasta que la luz parpadee.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio clearly realizes the requested social role, using a deliberate, patient, and professional delivery that perfectly matches a customer service agent guiding a client.

instruction_evidence.polite_and_patient: The speaker uses slow pacing and deliberate pauses to convey patience and clarity.
instruction_evidence.professional_guidance: The tone is formal and instructional, strongly evoking a telephone support scenario.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The voice sounds smooth, clear, and human-like without distracting synthetic artifacts.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The measured delivery and well-placed pauses greatly enhance the instructional and patient nature of the persona.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Adopt a warm and engaging persona, talking in a natural, conversational style suitable for an audio program.
text: Pienso mucho en el concepto de memoria, en cómo seleccionamos qué recordar y qué olvidar. Nuestros recuerdos no son grabaciones fieles del pasado, sino historias que nos contamos a nosotros mismos, editadas una y otra vez hasta que encajan en la narrativa de quiénes queremos ser.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The speaker successfully adopts a highly convincing, warm, and conversational tone, sounding exactly like a thoughtful podcast host.

instruction_evidence.language: The audio is spoken in clear Spanish.
instruction_evidence.persona: The warm, engaging, and conversational style is strongly evident through thoughtful pacing and natural phrasing, perfectly fitting an audio program host.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The speech is incredibly fluid and human-like, with natural micro-pauses and a realistic conversational cadence.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The expressive variation, including thoughtful hesitations and a warm, inviting intonation, greatly enhances the intended persona.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Speak in an engaging and enthusiastic narrative style, as if you are leading a group of people and sharing a fascinating story about a landmark.
text: Se dice que en las noches de luna llena, el espíritu del antiguo guardián del castillo todavía recorre estas murallas. Muchos afirman haber escuchado sus pasos resonando en los pasillos de piedra, un eco de una lealtad que trasciende el tiempo.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio clearly realizes the requested tour guide persona with an engaging and enthusiastic narrative delivery suitable for addressing a group.

instruction_evidence.persona_and_style: The speaker projects their voice with an enthusiastic, storytelling tone that strongly evokes the social role of a tour guide sharing a local legend.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The voice exhibits minor synthetic stiffness in its cadence and intonation, preventing a perfect naturalness score.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The delivery is highly dynamic, with well-placed emphasis and engaging variations that enhance the storytelling.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Adopt a calm and knowledgeable persona, providing important health information in a clear and supportive way.
text: Un descanso adecuado es esencial para la recuperación física y mental. Intente dormir entre siete y ocho horas cada noche para mantener un buen nivel de energía.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The speaker successfully adopts a calm, knowledgeable, and reassuring tone, perfectly matching the requested persona of a supportive health professional.

instruction_evidence.language: The audio is spoken in Spanish.
instruction_evidence.persona: The delivery is steady, well-paced, and gentle, clearly conveying a calm, knowledgeable, and supportive attitude suitable for a medical professional.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The speech sounds very human-like, with natural pauses and a smooth flow, free from synthetic artifacts.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The careful pacing and measured intonation strongly enhance the supportive and informative nature of the message.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Your voice should be authoritative and easy to understand, as if you are giving important information over a public address system.
text: Se ha informado de un cambio de última hora en la plataforma de salida. El tren con destino a la costa saldrá ahora desde la vía número cinco. Repito, vía número cinco.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio successfully adopts the deliberate, authoritative, and highly articulated delivery typical of a public address system announcer, even though the voice quality itself sounds synthetic.

instruction_evidence.authoritative_and_clear: The speaker uses a very deliberate, measured pace with clear articulation that makes the information easy to understand.
instruction_evidence.public_address_persona: The formal cadence and emphasis on key phrases strongly evoke the scenario of a station announcer.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The rhythm, pitch contours, and pauses sound distinctly robotic and stilted, lacking smooth human phrasing.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: While the persona is achieved through pacing, the expressive variation is quite flat and rigid.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Deliver the following as a knowledgeable and patient educator explaining a complex topic to an audience.
text: La Revolución Industrial no fue un evento único, sino un largo proceso de transformación económica y social que comenzó en Gran Bretaña en el siglo dieciocho. Se caracterizó por el paso de una economía agraria y artesanal a una dominada por la industria y la producción mecanizada.

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio fails to portray a knowledgeable and patient educator. The delivery is extremely hesitant, choppy, and lacks the confidence and clarity expected of a teacher. There are also unnatural pauses and a hallucinated sigh at the end.

instruction_evidence.social_role: The speaker sounds hesitant and unsure, completely contradicting the requested 'knowledgeable and patient educator' persona.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The speech is very robotic, disjointed, and includes inappropriate pauses and a strange noise at the end.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The delivery lacks the expressive shaping needed for an educational explanation.

instruction: Speak in Spanish. Your delivery should be informal and full of genuine, spontaneous excitement, like someone reacting in real time to a surprising event.
text: ¡Pero qué es esto! ¡Qué jugada tan espectacular! De verdad, esto es algo que no se ve todos los días. ¡Estoy sin palabras!

lalm_eval.brief_reason: The audio perfectly captures the informal, highly energetic, and spontaneous delivery expected of an excited live-stream host reacting in real time.

instruction_evidence.persona: The lively and informal tone strongly evokes a live-stream host or commentator.
instruction_evidence.spontaneous_excitement: The voice is full of genuine enthusiasm, with rapid pacing and enthusiastic pitch variations on the exclamations.

bonus_evidence.naturalness: The voice sounds smooth, human-like, and avoids synthetic stiffness even at a high energy level.
bonus_evidence.expressiveness: The prosody is dynamic and highly expressive, effectively conveying surprise and excitement.
